notes.title: Aphotic has won an award!
notes.content:
HeroFest 2024
I recently had the chance to meet some of you at HeroFest in Bern, to discuss and test the game together! This was Aphotic's first appearance at a public event, and the game was in top shape. Many of you played the demo at the Play Don't Tell booth, and I am happy to say that your feedback was positive. I'd like to thank all the kind messages: they're a great help in keeping the project going!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43462061/41df8258079a23b4837d2139acb08d6a5f532b33.jpg

An award for Aphotic
For the first time since its creation, HeroFest organized an awards ceremony for the video games presented at the event, and I'm proud to announce that Aphotic won the Nox award for Excellence in technical achievement. I'm even prouder that this is the first event Aphotic has participated in, so I'm excited about the future of the game's development.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43462061/c1b362edfb8bc15e1c42c484887b156687eabd43.jpg

Share your feedback
Also, you can now give me feedback on the demo via this quick form. All your comments are valuable to me and will be carefully taken into account. Thank you to those who have already completed it.

See you soon, and have fun!
